index.title: The Attention Row That Masks Everything
index.prompt: Implement causal plus padding masked attention, find the query rows where every key is masked, and fix the 0/0 that turns the loss into NaN.
index.answer: Auto-graded inside the notebook. n_dead_rows, n_nonfinite_naive, n_nonfinite_safe, safe_out_sum and row_sum_max_err must each match the reference within 1e-6 * (1 + |reference|), row_sum_max_err must be below 1e-9, and the naive version must produce non-finite entries while the safe one produces none.

index.title: Why Every Transformer Moved the LayerNorm
index.prompt: Backpropagate through 48 pre-norm and 48 post-norm residual blocks and measure how much gradient each design delivers to the first layer.
index.answer: Auto-graded inside the notebook. The sum and one fixed random projection of the pre-norm and post-norm gradient-norm curves, and the pre-norm ratio, must each match the reference within 1e-6 * (1 + |reference|), an absolute 1e-6 floor for the near-zero post-norm curve, and pre-norm must deliver at least 1000 times more gradient to block 1 than post-norm does.
